summary: Hall Chadwick is a large national chartered accounting and advisory firm (59 partners and 920+ professionals per its site) with its Sydney office at Level 40, 2 Park Street. Abeed Ahmad joined as Director, Forensic Technology in April 2026 after EY, HKA and Axiom Forensics, and is a data analytics specialist in transaction tracing across millions of records, ASIC remediation and class action work. The firm added two forensic partners in May 2026. Fit is weak for everyday reconciliation, so the follow-up leans on his transaction-matching background and asks about the right internal owner.
